description:
RT'S Racing Tornadoes is a multidisciplinary team of astrophysicists, aerospace engineers, exobiologists, and flight specialists dedicated to pushing the boundaries of human and robotic presence beyond Earth’s orbit.
​Combining cutting-edge propulsion research with autonomous navigation systems, RT'S Racing Tornadoes designs, launches, and operates deep-space missions aimed at charting unexplored celestial bodies, assessing off-world resource viability, and searching for signs of life.
